O.outcome_detail: proportion of appendicectomies in which the JR acted as trainer

cells.quote: Towards the end of that year, JR 1 was TT in 3 cases (8.8%) and JR 2 was TT in 5 cases (19.2%); in all cases the learner was a CT.
cells.note: Retrospective observational comparison of two new Junior Registrars; no statistical test comparing their TT proportions is reported.
